stock_segments.discussion_summary: Detailed discussion of short seller report from UK firm alleging aggressive accounting - capitalizing development costs as revenues. Report notes 1.5 billion SEK reported profits since 2015 vs -228 million free cash flow. Hosts defend company, noting they're building pipeline of 150 games. Wingenfors owns large stake, making stock illiquid. Hosts traded the volatility, buying at 62-70 SEK range and selling for small profit. Short report timing was strategic - released before November 14 report, preventing insiders from buying. Target from short seller is 30 SEK (6 billion valuation) vs current 20 billion.

De menar väl då att, eller en bracer THQ säger att de har ju satsat på nya spel, så istället för att man gör en jättestor vinst så lägger man allting på utveckling och det blir ju då kommande vinster.
